candidates.statement: If G is semiabelian and Z ⊂G is a smooth closed subvariety, then the number (−1)dim(Z)χ(Z, C) is nonnegative and coincides with gdeg(Z). Indeed, CZ[dim(Z)] is perverse and its characteristic cycle is [T ∗ ZG] taken with multiplicity 1.

candidates.statement: If W ⊂V is a generic hyperplane, then deg(f) is equal to the number of x ∈M such that f(x) ∈G(k, W) ⊂G(k, V ). For any such x the map f is locally (in the analytic or etale cohomology) an embedding near x and the intersection of f(M) and G(k, W) is transversal at x. When k = n −1, we have f M = M and deg(f) is the degree of f in the usual sense.
